name: Linear MCP
what: Linear's official MCP server for finding, creating and updating issues, projects and comments from your AI tool.
who: Teams and solo builders tracking work in Linear.

setup.text: In Claude Code, add it, then run /mcp to sign in:
setup.code: claude mcp add --transport http linear-server https://mcp.linear.app/mcp

prompts: Show my assigned issues for this cycle sorted by priority.
Create a bug issue for the login redirect problem.
Add a comment to issue ENG-123 with what I just fixed.
